mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT e.employee_id, e.employee_no, e.employee_name, d.department_name FROM employee e INNER JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id INNER JOIN employee_role er ON er.employee_id = e.employee_id INNER JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = er.role_id WHERE e.active = TRUE AND d.active = TRUE AND r.active = TRUE AND r.role_code = 'SALES' ORDER BY e.employee_name ASC, e.employee_no ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.employee_id) FROM employee e INNER JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id INNER JOIN employee_role er ON er.employee_id = e.employee_id INNER JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = er.role_id WHERE e.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND e.active = TRUE AND d.active = TRUE AND r.active = TRUE AND r.role_code = 'SALES'
